title: graphics_plan
description: The graphics plan written by scripts/graphics_plan.py: where a graphic overlay should appear on the final timeline, which template it uses and with what props. A human approves or rejects each entry (approved) before scripts/graphics.py --plan renders the approved ones as ProRes 4444 .mov overlays with alpha. Entries may come from the model or from Mango markers in markers.json (lot 5, scripts/fcproj_markers.py).

props.description: template props; the required keys depend on the entry's template (see oneOf below)

role.description: lower_third: role or subtitle line under the name

number.description: counter: the number shown (kept as written, e.g. '42' or '4.2')

label.description: counter: the label under the number

text.description: callout: the short text or terminal line

style.description: callout: plain text or a terminal line typed out

marker_ref.description: origin of the entry when it came from a markers.json Mango marker (scripts/fcproj_markers.py output)

id.description: stable entry id, unique inside the plan (e.g. g1, g2)

time_s.description: timeline time in seconds where the graphic enters

duration_s.description: how long the graphic stays on screen

reason.description: why this graphic belongs at this time

approved.description: false until a human flips it; graphics.py --plan renders approved entries only

hint.description: the marker name/comment or other hint the model proposed from

source_words.description: path of the words JSON the plan was generated from

markers_path.description: path of the markers.json the plan was generated from, if any
